es: Elaborar un mini informe sobre el transporte escolar y presentarlo en un resumen oral de un minuto con punto clave, cautela y recomendación.

teaching.en: This report gives an overview of how students commute to school.
teaching.es: Este informe ofrece una visión general de cómo se desplazan los estudiantes al colegio.
teaching.explanationEs: Give an overview introduce el panorama general; commute es el trayecto diario al colegio o al trabajo.

prompt.es: Escribe el mini informe: objetivo, resultados con cifras, un matiz y una recomendación.

answer.text: The aim of this report is to describe how students travel to school. The method was a survey of 100 students. The main findings show that 52 percent of respondents come by school bus, whereas only 6 percent cycle. Furthermore, 35 students said that the bus journey takes more than forty minutes. It appears that long journeys may be a problem for students who live far away, although more evidence is needed. The conclusion is that the school bus is the most common way to travel. Therefore, it is recommended that the school should consider a second morning bus, which would probably shorten the commute.
accepted: The aim of this report is to describe how students travel to school. The method was a survey of 100 students. The main findings show that 52 percent of respondents come by school bus, whereas only 6 percent cycle. Furthermore, 35 students said that the bus journey takes more than forty minutes. It appears that long journeys may be a problem for students who live far away, although more evidence is needed. The conclusion is that the school bus is the most common way to travel. Therefore, it is recommended that the school should consider a second morning bus, which would probably shorten the commute.

This report gives an overview of how students get to school. A survey of 100 students was carried out. The findings show that more than half of the respondents, 52 percent, use the school bus, while only 6 percent cycle and 12 percent come by car. In addition, 35 students said the journey by bus is longer than forty minutes. There is some evidence that long journeys may affect students who live far away, but it remains unclear how many are affected. To conclude, the bus is the main way to travel. We recommend that the school consider an extra bus in the morning.

feedback.es: El mini informe lleva el objetivo, dos resultados con cifras, una afirmación matizada y una recomendación, con tono neutro.

origin.text: Encuesta del consejo escolar a 100 estudiantes sobre cómo llegan al colegio: 52 en autobús escolar, 30 a pie, 12 en coche y 6 en bicicleta. El viaje en autobús dura más de 40 minutos para 35 estudiantes. Escribe entre 100 y 170 palabras: el objetivo, dos resultados con cifras, una afirmación matizada y una recomendación.

prompt.es: Escribe el resumen oral de un minuto con anuncio, punto clave, cautela y recomendación.

answer.text: I will outline the main findings of our survey on digital habits. The key point is that 64 of the 80 students use a phone for more than three hours a day. Only a minority, 20 students, sleep fewer than seven hours. It appears that heavy users tend to sleep less, although more evidence is needed. To conclude, we recommend a phone-free hour before bed.
accepted: I will outline the main findings of our survey on digital habits. The key point is that 64 of the 80 students use a phone for more than three hours a day. Only a minority, 20 students, sleep fewer than seven hours. It appears that heavy users tend to sleep less, although more evidence is needed. To conclude, we recommend a phone-free hour before bed.

I will briefly present our survey on digital habits. The main point is that most students, 64 out of 80, use a phone for more than three hours daily. It seems that heavy users may sleep less, but we cannot be sure. Only 20 students sleep fewer than seven hours. In conclusion, we recommend one hour without phones before bed.

feedback.es: El resumen anuncia, da el punto clave con una cifra, añade una cautela y cierra con una recomendación, en frases cortas.

origin.text: Encuesta sobre hábitos digitales (80 estudiantes): 64 usan el móvil más de tres horas al día; solo 20 duermen menos de siete horas; los que más lo usan parecen dormir menos.
